title: Tools
lead: Free browser tools for UBC students. One is ready now; more are in development.
seoDescription: Free UBC student tools in the browser. Open Schedule Maker, or check back for more.
scheduleMakerBody: Turn a Workday View My Courses Excel file into a weekly timetable. Pick courses, restyle the card, export PNG. Parsing never leaves this device.
comingSoonBody: The next tools will live here. Schedule Maker is the first — GPA, exam planners, and the rest are still being built.
